pages.title: Read the situation

pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: Dead phone, no charger
paragraphs: New York episode: phone died at 4 pm after use as a map; charger at hotel; dinner planned for 7 pm; doorman suggested café, no free outlets; waited twenty minutes; a woman lent a power bank; Ana had a cable and arrived by taxi at 8 pm. Do not infer that Kim was the stranger who helped.

pages.title: How was New York?
pages.instruction: Listen for the activity, the result and the follow-up question

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.translation: E aí, como foi Nova York?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Pretty good, but on the second day, my phone died at four in the afternoon
lines.audioText: Pretty good, but on the second day, my phone died at four in the afternoon.
lines.translation: Bem bom, mas no segundo dia o meu celular descarregou às quatro da tarde

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’d been using it as a map all day, and I didn’t notice how low the battery was. And I’d left my charger at the hotel
lines.audioText: I’d been using it as a map all day, and I didn’t notice how low the battery was. And I’d left my charger at the hotel.
lines.translation: Eu vinha usando o celular como mapa o dia todo, e não reparei na bateria. E tinha deixado o carregador no hotel

questions.prompt: What had Ana left at the hotel?

pages.title: Looking for help
pages.instruction: Listen for the activity, the result and the follow-up question

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Why didn’t you go back to the hotel?
lines.audioText: Why didn’t you go back to the hotel?
lines.translation: Por que você não voltou para o hotel?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I tried, but I got lost. And the team dinner was at seven. The address was in a message from Raj!
lines.audioText: I tried, but I got lost. And the team dinner was at seven. The address was in a message from Raj!
lines.translation: Eu tentei, mas me perdi. E o jantar da equipe era às sete. O endereço estava numa mensagem do Raj!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.translation: E aí, o que você fez?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I asked a doorman for help, and he told me about a café. But there were no free outlets
lines.audioText: I asked a doorman for help, and he told me about a café. But there were no free outlets.
lines.translation: Pedi ajuda a um porteiro, e ele me falou de um café. Mas não tinha nenhuma tomada livre

questions.prompt: Why didn’t the café solve the charging problem?

pages.title: The turning point
pages.instruction: Listen for the activity, the result and the follow-up question

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’d been waiting there alone for twenty minutes when a woman lent me her power bank. Luckily, I had my cable
lines.audioText: I’d been waiting there alone for twenty minutes when a woman lent me her power bank. Luckily, I had my cable.
lines.translation: Eu estava esperando lá sozinha havia vinte minutos quando uma moça me emprestou a bateria portátil dela. Por sorte, eu estava com o meu cabo

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So did you make it to the dinner?
lines.audioText: So did you make it to the dinner?
lines.translation: E você chegou ao jantar, afinal?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Eventually, yes. I caught a taxi and got there at eight. By then, they’d been waiting for an hour!
lines.audioText: Eventually, yes. I caught a taxi and got there at eight. By then, they’d been waiting for an hour!
lines.translation: No fim, sim. Peguei um táxi e cheguei às oito. Àquela altura, eles já estavam esperando havia uma hora!

questions.prompt: What enabled Ana to retrieve the address and travel?
questions.answer: A woman lent a power bank, so Ana could use her phone

pages.title: Explain how the trip unfolded

pages.title: Raj’s message at seven twenty
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi Ana, it’s Raj. It’s seven twenty. We’d been waiting for you at the door for fifteen minutes, so we got a table. I’ve called you three times, but no answer! Sarah thinks you got lost in Times Square. The food here is pretty good, so we ordered a pizza for you. You need a power bank, Ana! Call me when you get this, or just come straight to the restaurant, OK?
pages.audioText: Hi Ana, it’s Raj. It’s seven twenty. We’d been waiting for you at the door for fifteen minutes, so we got a table. I’ve called you three times, but no answer! Sarah thinks you got lost in Times Square. The food here is pretty good, so we ordered a pizza for you. You need a power bank, Ana! Call me when you get this, or just come straight to the restaurant, OK?
